# Synthetic STARTTLS stripping: server omits the extension on a
# TLS-expected session. Wire is CRLF.
S: 220 fake.kiwi-test.invalid ESMTP FakeKIWI
C: EHLO client.kiwi-test.invalid
S: 250-fake.kiwi-test.invalid
S: 250-AUTH PLAIN LOGIN
S: 250 SIZE 10485760
# No 250-STARTTLS line: client must emit STARTTLS-STRIPPED evidence and
# refuse-or-warn per policy, never proceed silently in plaintext.
